title: demorchis khangii
intro: Demorchis khangii, commonly known as the Himalayan cobra lily or Himalayan orchid, is a rare and endangered orchid species native to the Himalayas. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Demorchis khangii include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and show potential in treating various diseases, although further research is needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
